title: a Real derived from dimensioned quantities with a hand-rolled conversion
note: FOUND 2026-09-02 by the I1 exploration, FIXED 2026-09-03. `enduranceMin : Real = capacity / cruisePower * 60.0` derives to 212 677 s — the author's minutes read as seconds — and an engine that evaluated it would answer SATISFIED against `100.0 [min]` (6000 s) where the model's own intent (59 min) is violated; the false-satisfied band runs to ~3544 min. A derived feature whose dimension disagrees with its declared type is now excluded from unit-aware evaluation (the constraint answers unknown) and `derived-dimension-mismatch` names it. The repair retypes the feature to the kind its derivation has and lets the unit literal on the comparison convert. Two false-positive patterns are NOT warned: a user `attribute def :> ISQ::MassValue` is walked to its ISQ kind before the claim is judged, and a pure ratio keeps its type when the inlined constant carries its unit — `mtow / 25.0` becomes `mtow / 25.0 [kg]`, the second repair the hint names.
